response.sql: SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS points_total, AVG(CASE WHEN laps IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(laps) NOT IN ('', '\N') THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) AS driver_totals;
